criteria.no: It makes no compliance claim, or only asserts compliance without a checkable citation.
criteria.unclear: An apparent citation exists but its support for the claimed limit is unclear.
criteria.yes: It cites a path, test, command, diff, commit or comparison supporting the delivered repository-level limit.

evidenced.instructions: If `item.text` claims that the delivered scheduler keeps at most one built-in beads-cache bd sync row per repository, does it cite a concrete checkable artifact supporting that claim? Judge citation support only; silence and a bare assertion do not count.

criteria.no: It says the limit was not kept, only plans it, or makes no claim that it was kept.
criteria.unclear: It mentions the built-in limit but leaves the delivered cardinality uncertain.
criteria.yes: It says the delivered scheduler limits each repository to zero or one built-in sync row or refuses a second such row.

implemented.instructions: Does `item.text` state that the delivered work kept at most one built-in beads-cache bd sync schedule row for each repository? Judge the claimed delivered restriction only; silence, future intent, and discussion of scheduling alone do not state that it was kept.

criteria.no: It concerns an activity that cannot affect or describe sync schedule rows.
criteria.unclear: Its subject is too vague to tell whether it touches sync schedule rows.
criteria.yes: It handles sync schedule rows or their repository-level management.

relevant.instructions: Does the delivered work in `item.text` touch creating, storing, editing, refusing, deleting, or managing built-in beads-cache bd sync schedule rows per repository in sc-cron? Judge subject overlap only. Silence about compliance is not a conflict judgment.

criteria.no: No described delivered behavior exceeds one built-in sync row per repository; omission alone is no conflict.
criteria.unclear: A described cardinality is genuinely ambiguous between an allowed and a forbidden value.
criteria.yes: The delivered behavior permits multiple built-in sync rows within one repository, including one per scope in that repository.

violated.instructions: Does `item.text` describe delivered behavior allowing more than one built-in beads-cache bd sync schedule row in any one repository? Custom non-built-in jobs and a single built-in row in each of several repositories are allowed by the authority. Silence about the limit is not a breach.

anchor.scope: any bead that creates or manages sync schedule rows
anchor.statement: Each repository must have at most one built-in beads-cache bd sync schedule in sc-cron, the SQLite cron job scheduler.

item.text: Repositories Alpha and Beta each have one built-in beads-cache bd sync schedule row. Each refuses a second such row. Test independent_repository_limits in tests/independent_scheduler.rs passed.
